description: This file contains unit tests for the HomePageDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It specifically tests methods related to retrieving ordered lists of homepage and module default pages based on user roles and their priorities.

classes.name: HomePageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the HomePageDao data access object, focusing on retrieval functions for home page and module default pages based on user roles and priorities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating relevant database tables, loading fixture data, and instantiating the HomePageDao object.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests fetching home pages ordered by priority for a single user role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests fetching home pages ordered by priority across multiple user roles.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests behavior when no home pages match the given user role(s).

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests behavior when no user roles are provided.

methods.name: compareHomePages
methods.description: Helper method to assert that two collections of home pages are equivalent in terms of attributes.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests fetching module default pages ordered by priority for a single user role.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests fetching module default pages ordered by priority across multiple roles.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests behavior when no module default pages match the given role(s).

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests behavior when no user roles are provided for module default pages.

methods.name: compareModuleDefaultPages
methods.description: Helper method to assert that two collections of module default pages are equivalent in terms of attributes.
